set.statement: `genesis run resume <run>` continues a stopped run from its journal without a daemon, never redoing a finished step; it refuses an interrupted run whose change set has landed, been rejected, withdrawn or superseded, except that a plan-workflow run whose change set has landed is resumed (plan-run-resumes-landed-record).

rhiza run resume refuses an interrupted run whose change set is no longer accepted, naming the state and rhiza run abandon; a plan-workflow run whose change set has landed is the exception (plan-run-resumes-landed-record)
rhiza run resume refuses a run whose change set is no longer accepted, as the daemon does, except a plan-workflow run whose change set has landed (Decision plan-resume-landed-record-milestone-6)
